## Checklist

- [ ] Content-only or functional change is stated.
- [ ] No operator private-ops state (mailbox, backup, export, Drive, chat-search, notify status) is in the diff or the PR body.
- [ ] Rebase-merge only.
- [ ] No secrets.
- [ ] No direct push to main.
- [ ] Edition unchanged unless this is a functional, activation, eval, or hard-stop change.
